Description:
This city hotel is situated within walking distance of Hillcrest's tree lined streets, boutiques, galleries, elegant restaurants and sidewalk cafes. The unique location of this property allows easy access to downtown, Balboa Park, Sea World and the San Diego Zoo. It is also just minutes away from the airport and two of San Diego's major medical centres.

Renovated in 2009 with a total of 80 guest rooms, this air-conditioned hotel is an all-suite property with all the conveniences of home, whether travelling for business or leisure. The hotel features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, a cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. Further on-site amenities include a café, breakfast room, conference facilities, wireless Internet access, a laundry service and both garage parking and a car park for those arriving by car.

All of the hotel rooms are fully equipped with an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and hairdryer, as well as a kitchenette, work space and a sitting area designed for comfort and functionality. Guests can savour a fine night's sleep in the double or king-size beds and take advantage of in-room appliances ranging from satellite TV, to a radio, fridge, cooker, microwave, a washing machine, ironing set and tea and coffee making facilities. A safe, Internet access, individually regulated air conditioning and heating, and either a balcony or terrace also feature as standard in all rooms.

The hotel features a heated outdoor swimming pool with a children's swimming area and a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols laid out ready for use. Guests can also relax in the hot tub, while those with a passion for the fairway will find the River Run Golf Course just a short drive from the hotel.

A deluxe continental breakfast is offered each morning along with evening receptions for a more enjoyable stay.
